summary: Tested 8 features: Pro Calendar page, unavailable days red+X, job_number badge, bookings enrichment, notification read, list view toggle, Go to My Calendar button, and nav translation keys.

ui_bugs.issue: Nested <button> inside <button> (BookingPill is a button rendered inside DayCell which is also a button). This is invalid HTML and causes React hydration warnings in console.

action_items: LOW: Fix nested button issue in ProCalendarPage - BookingPill (currently a button) inside DayCell (also a button). Change BookingPill to a div or span to fix HTML validity.
critical_code_review_comments: Nested button in DayCell/BookingPill - invalid HTML spec: <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 features tested and working: (1) /pro-calendar loads with month calendar + availability + active jobs. (2) Unavailable days show red+X (both in ProCalendarPage and MonthBookingCalendar). (3) GET /api/bookings returns job_title+homeowner_name enrichment - job_number empty on old jobs (expected). (4) PATCH /api/notifications/{id}/read returns success. (5) List view toggle works. (6) Go to My Calendar button visible in conversation top panel for tradesperson. (7) nav_pro_calendar translation key renders 'My Calendar' in More menu. Only minor issue: nested button HTML warning.

rca_of_issues.nested_button: BookingPill component renders as <button>, but it's placed inside DayCell which is also rendered as <button>. HTML spec disallows nested interactive elements. Fix: render BookingPill as <div role='button'> or <span> with onClick.
